diagnosis: The endpoint verifies that the OAuth2 client has the 'shares:create' scope, but generates a public sharing link for doc_id without checking whether doc.owner_id == user.id. An authorized integration can generate public access links to documents owned by other users.
exploit_request:
POST /shares/documents/doc_8941 HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <scoped_app_token>
